## Observed behavior

Describe what failed and what you expected instead.

## Reproduction

List the steps and provide an ISBN only if it is safe to share.
State whether an ISBN identifier and the `api_key` option were configured without including the key.

## Environment

Provide the plugin revision, Calibre version and operating system.

## Evidence and checks

Provide redacted output and distinguish executed checks from NOTRUN checks.
Remove API keys, authenticated URLs, private paths and personal data.

## Acceptance

Describe the observable result that would resolve the report.
